Randomizes the values of {c_important}all base{/c} Affixes on an equipment or Talisman item.

This does not affect:
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5} Greater Affixes
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:Tempering_Basic_Icon,1.5} Tempered Affixes
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:Affix_Reroll,1.2} Enchanted Affixes
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:AttributeBullet_AffixTransfigured,1.5} Transfigured Affixes
{icon:bullet,1.2} {icon:bullet_legendarystar,2} Legendary Powers
{icon:bullet,1.2} {icon:uniquestar,2} Unique Powers
